audit_items.proof_trace: syncAllDiscordRoles() is called unconditionally at L693 after all three DB update blocks (HS, JHS, OB/OG) complete successfully. Any DB error throws before L693, but in that case the bulk update itself failed so the post-condition precondition is not satisfied. The fire-and-forget return value discard at L693 is intentional design (CLAUDE.md: 'These calls are fire-and-forget').
